# Exact cover solve fixed orientation, stopping up to 20 solutions
sols=[]
def solve(used, covered, chosen):
 if len(used)==len(pieces):
  if covered==mask: sols.append(chosen.copy())
  return len(sols)>=20
 rem=mask-covered
 # cell candidate placements with unused piece, disjoint
 best=None; opts=None
 for cell in rem:
  cand=[p for p in by_cell[cell] if p[0] not in used and not (p[3]&covered)]
  if not cand:return False
  if opts is None or len(cand)<len(opts): best=cell;opts=cand
 for p in opts:
  i,r,c,cells=p
  used.add(i);chosen.append(p)
  if solve(used,covered|cells,chosen):return True
  chosen.pop();used.remove(i)
 return False
solve(set(),set(),[])
len(sols), sols[:1]
